# Resize Handle > Edge and corner grip for resizing a positioned box; the host owns the drag math. Status: experimental. This file matches the installed `resize-handle` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/resize-handle.json ``` With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/resize-handle.md`. ## Registry dependencies - `core` ## Exports - `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/resize-handle-knobs`: `resizeHandleKnobs`, types `ResizeHandleKnobStyle` - `@/components/control-ui/ui/resize-handle`: `resizeHandleDirections`, `ResizeHandle`, types `ResizeHandleDirection`, `ResizeHandleProps` ## Composition ### Resizable box Inside a zoomed canvas, border widths snap to device pixels before the scale applies: draw the rim with --cui-resize-handle-shadow instead, sized by the inverse scale. --cui-resize-handle-radius shapes the grip and its focus ring together. ```tsx positioned box ``` ## Usage ```tsx "use client"; import type { KeyboardEvent, PointerEvent } from "react"; import { useRef, useState } from "react"; import { ResizeHandle, type ResizeHandleDirection, resizeHandleDirections } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/resize-handle"; import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography"; type Frame = { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number }; type DragSession = { pointerId: number; startX: number; startY: number; startFrame: Frame }; const MIN_FRAME_SIZE_PX = 64; const KEYBOARD_STEP_PX = 1; const KEYBOARD_SHIFT_STEP_PX = 10; const INITIAL_FRAME: Frame = { x: 96, y: 48, width: 240, height: 144 }; const DIRECTION_LABELS: Record = { n: "top edge", ne: "top-right corner", e: "right edge", se: "bottom-right corner", s: "bottom edge", sw: "bottom-left corner", w: "left edge", nw: "top-left corner", }; const ARROW_DELTAS: Partial> = { ArrowLeft: { x: -1, y: 0 }, ArrowRight: { x: 1, y: 0 }, ArrowUp: { x: 0, y: -1 }, ArrowDown: { x: 0, y: 1 }, }; function resizeFrame(frame: Frame, direction: ResizeHandleDirection, deltaX: number, deltaY: number): Frame { const next = { ...frame }; if (direction.includes("e")) next.width = Math.max(MIN_FRAME_SIZE_PX, frame.width + deltaX); if (direction.includes("s")) next.height = Math.max(MIN_FRAME_SIZE_PX, frame.height + deltaY); if (direction.includes("w")) { next.width = Math.max(MIN_FRAME_SIZE_PX, frame.width - deltaX); next.x = frame.x + frame.width - next.width; } if (direction.includes("n")) { next.height = Math.max(MIN_FRAME_SIZE_PX, frame.height - deltaY); next.y = frame.y + frame.height - next.height; } return next; } export function PrimitiveResizeHandleExample() { const [frame, setFrame] = useState(INITIAL_FRAME); const dragRef = useRef(null); function startDrag(event: PointerEvent) { if (!event.isPrimary || event.button !== 0) return; event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); dragRef.current = { pointerId: event.pointerId, startX: event.clientX, startY: event.clientY, startFrame: frame }; } function drag(event: PointerEvent, direction: ResizeHandleDirection) { const session = dragRef.current; if (session?.pointerId !== event.pointerId) return; setFrame(resizeFrame(session.startFrame, direction, event.clientX - session.startX, event.clientY - session.startY)); } function endDrag(event: PointerEvent) { if (dragRef.current?.pointerId === event.pointerId) dragRef.current = null; } function resizeWithKeyboard(event: KeyboardEvent, direction: ResizeHandleDirection) { const delta = ARROW_DELTAS[event.key]; if (!delta) return; event.preventDefault(); const step = event.shiftKey ? KEYBOARD_SHIFT_STEP_PX : KEYBOARD_STEP_PX; setFrame((current) => resizeFrame(current, direction, delta.x * step, delta.y * step)); } return (
{Math.round(frame.width)} × {Math.round(frame.height)} {resizeHandleDirections.map((direction) => ( drag(event, direction)} onPointerUp={endDrag} onPointerCancel={endDrag} onKeyDown={(event) => resizeWithKeyboard(event, direction)} /> ))}
); } ``` ## Anatomy Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`. - `resize-handle` - `root`: `data-direction` (`e` | `n` | `ne` | `nw` | `s` | `se` | `sw` | `w`) ## Knobs Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin. ### resize-handle - `--cui-resize-handle-size`: `10px` - `--cui-resize-handle-hit-size`: `var(--target-min)` - `--cui-resize-handle-background`: `var(--background)` - `--cui-resize-handle-hover-background`: `oklch(from var(--primary) l c h / 0.1)` - `--cui-resize-handle-border-color`: `var(--primary)` - `--cui-resize-handle-border-width`: `var(--control-rim-width)` - `--cui-resize-handle-radius`: `0px` - `--cui-resize-handle-shadow`: `none` ## Links - Online docs (latest release): https://control-ui.dev/components/resize-handle - Anatomy contract: https://control-ui.dev/r/contract/resize-handle.json
